{"text":"# 📋 Detailed UI Requirements - Online Academic Journal Website

## 🎯 **Project Overview**
**Platform**: Web-based Academic Journal Management System  
**Target Users**: Readers, Authors, Administrators  
**Purpose**: Digital platform for sharing and managing academic research articles  

---

## 🔐 **1. Authentication Module**

### **1.1 Login Screen Requirements**

#### **Core Functionality:**
- **User Authentication**: Support login for 3 user types (Reader, Author, Admin)
- **Input Validation**: Real-time validation for email format and password strength
- **Security Features**: Password encryption, session management, "Remember Me" option
- **Error Handling**: Clear error messages for invalid credentials, account lockout protection

#### **UI/UX Requirements:**
```
Layout: Split-screen design (50/50 ratio)
- Left Panel: Branding area with gradient background
  - Logo and platform name prominently displayed
  - Tagline: "Leading platform for academic knowledge sharing"
  - Background: Blue gradient (#1A66CC to #3B82F6)

- Right Panel: Login form container
  - White background with subtle shadow
  - Form fields: Email, Password
  - Primary CTA button: "Login"
  - Secondary link: "Don't have an account? Register now"

Visual Elements:
- Input fields: 370x56px, rounded corners (12px), light gray background
- Button: Full-width, gradient background, shadow effect
- Typography: Clean, professional sans-serif font
```

#### **Responsive Behavior:**
- **Desktop**: Maintain split-screen layout
- **Tablet**: Stack vertically, reduce padding
- **Mobile**: Single column, full-width form

### **1.2 Registration Screen Requirements**

#### **Core Functionality:**
- **Account Creation**: Support registration for Readers and Authors
- **Form Validation**: Real-time validation for all required fields
- **Role Selection**: Dropdown to choose user type (Reader/Author)
- **Email Verification**: Send confirmation email after registration
- **Duplicate Prevention**: Check for existing email addresses

#### **UI/UX Requirements:**
```
Layout: Centered form design
- Form container: 600x700px, white background
- Form fields: Name, Email, Password, Confirm Password, Role
- Role selection: Visual toggle or dropdown with clear descriptions
- Agreement checkbox: Terms and conditions acceptance
- Submit button: "Create Account"

Validation States:
- Success: Green checkmark, success message
- Error: Red border, inline error message
- Loading: Disabled state with spinner
```

---

## 📝 **2. Article Management Dashboard**

### **2.1 Main Dashboard Requirements**

#### **Core Functionality:**
- **Article Overview**: Display all articles with filtering and sorting
- **Search System**: Full-text search with advanced filters
- **Status Management**: Track article states (Draft, Pending, Published, Rejected)
- **Bulk Operations**: Select multiple articles for batch actions
- **Real-time Updates**: Live status updates and notifications

#### **UI/UX Requirements:**
```
Layout Structure:
├── Header Navigation (1440x80px)
│   ├── Logo (left)
│   ├── Global search bar (center)
│   └── User profile menu (right)
├── Sidebar Navigation (280px width)
│   ├── Dashboard
│   ├── Articles Management ← Active state
│   ├── Categories
│   ├── Authors
│   └── User Management
└── Main Content Area (1120px width)
    ├── Page header with breadcrumbs
    ├── Statistics cards row
    ├── Filters and search bar
    ├── Articles data table
    └── Pagination

Statistics Cards Design:
- Total Articles: Blue gradient background, large number display
- Published: Green gradient, success indicator
- Pending Review: Orange gradient, alert indicator
- Drafts: Gray gradient, neutral state

Data Table Features:
- Sortable columns: Title, Author, Category, Status, Date
- Row actions: View, Edit, Delete, Preview
- Status badges: Color-coded (Green=Published, Orange=Pending, Gray=Draft)
- Responsive: Horizontal scroll on smaller screens
```

### **2.2 Article Creation/Editing Interface**

#### **Core Functionality:**
- **Rich Text Editor**: WYSIWYG editor with formatting tools
- **Media Upload**: Support for images, videos, documents
- **Draft System**: Auto-save functionality every 30 seconds
- **Preview Mode**: Real-time preview of article layout
- **Metadata Management**: Tags, categories, abstract, keywords
- **Copyright Check**: Plagiarism detection integration
- **Submission Workflow**: Submit for review process

#### **UI/UX Requirements:**
```
Layout: Full-screen editor interface
├── Toolbar: Formatting options, save, preview, submit
├── Main Editor: Rich text editing area
├── Sidebar: 
│   ├── Article metadata
│   ├── Category selection
│   ├── Tags input
│   └── Media library
└── Footer: Word count, last saved time, action buttons

Editor Features:
- Toolbar: Bold, italic, headers, lists, links, media insert
- Auto-save indicator: Show save status visually
- Preview toggle: Switch between edit and preview modes
- Media drag-and-drop: Visual upload area
```

### **2.3 Article Review Interface (Admin)**

#### **Core Functionality:**
- **Review Queue**: List of articles pending approval
- **Review Tools**: Comments, suggestions, approval/rejection
- **Communication**: Direct messaging with authors
- **Version Control**: Track article revisions
- **Batch Review**: Approve/reject multiple articles

#### **UI/UX Requirements:**
```
Layout: Three-panel interface
├── Left Panel: Pending articles queue
├── Center Panel: Article content viewer
└── Right Panel: Review tools and comments

Review Tools:
- Approve button: Green, prominent
- Reject button: Red, secondary
- Request changes: Orange, with comment field
- Version history: Expandable timeline
- Comments system: Threaded conversations
```

---

## 🏷️ **3. Category Management Interface**

### **3.1 Category Dashboard Requirements**

#### **Core Functionality:**
- **Category CRUD**: Create, Read, Update, Delete categories
- **Hierarchy Management**: Support parent-child category relationships
- **Article Association**: View articles per category
- **Statistics**: Article count per category
- **Drag-and-Drop**: Reorder categories

#### **UI/UX Requirements:**
```
Layout: Grid + Sidebar design
├── Main Grid (900x600px):
│   └── Category cards in responsive grid
│       ├── Category icon/emoji
│       ├── Category name
│       ├── Article count
│       ├── Description snippet
│       └── Action buttons (Edit, Delete)
└── Sidebar Panel (380x600px):
    ├── "Add New Category" form
    ├── Category name input
    ├── Description textarea
    ├── Icon selection
    ├── Parent category dropdown
    └── Save/Cancel buttons

Category Card Design:
- Size: 330x120px
- White background with subtle shadow
- Hover effects: Slight scale and shadow increase
- Color coding: Different border colors for different types
- Interactive elements: Clear hover states
```

### **3.2 Category Form Requirements**

#### **Core Functionality:**
- **Form Validation**: Required fields, character limits
- **Icon Selection**: Emoji picker or icon library
- **Slug Generation**: Auto-generate URL-friendly slug
- **Preview**: Real-time preview of category card

#### **UI/UX Requirements:**
```
Form Layout:
- Name field: Required, 60 character limit
- Description: Optional, 200 character limit
- Icon selector: Visual picker with search
- Parent category: Dropdown with hierarchy display
- Slug field: Auto-generated, editable
- Active toggle: Enable/disable category

Validation States:
- Real-time validation with inline messages
- Character counters for text fields
- Required field indicators
```

---

## 👤 **4. Author Management Interface**

### **4.1 Authors Dashboard Requirements**

#### **Core Functionality:**
- **Author Directory**: Comprehensive list of all authors
- **Profile Management**: View and edit author information
- **Performance Metrics**: Articles count, citations, ratings
- **Search and Filter**: Find authors by name, expertise, institution
- **Communication Tools**: Contact authors directly

#### **UI/UX Requirements:**
```
Layout: Table + Profile Panel
├── Authors Table (1200x600px):
│   ├── Avatar column (40px circular images)
│   ├── Name and title
│   ├── Institution/affiliation
│   ├── Email contact
│   ├── Articles count
│   ├── Status (Active/Inactive)
│   └── Action buttons
└── Profile Panel (350x600px):
    ├── Large avatar (100px)
    ├── Basic information form
    ├── Biography section
    ├── Publication history
    └── Contact information

Table Features:
- Sortable columns: Name, Articles count, Last activity
- Search functionality: Real-time filtering
- Status indicators: Color-coded badges
- Pagination: 25 items per page
- Export functionality: CSV/PDF export

Profile Panel:
- Editable fields with save/cancel options
- Image upload for avatar
- Rich text editor for biography
- Publication list with links
```

### **4.2 Author Profile Requirements**

#### **Core Functionality:**
- **Personal Information**: Name, title, institution, contact
- **Professional Details**: Expertise areas, qualifications
- **Publication History**: List of published articles
- **Statistics Dashboard**: Views, downloads, citations
- **Document Management**: CV upload, certificates

#### **UI/UX Requirements:**
```
Profile Layout:
├── Header Section:
│   ├── Avatar upload (drag-and-drop)
│   ├── Name and title
│   └── Institution affiliation
├── Information Tabs:
│   ├── Personal Info
│   ├── Professional Details
│   ├── Publications
│   └── Statistics
└── Action Area:
    ├── Save changes button
    ├── Reset form button
    └── Deactivate account option

Form Design:
- Clean, modern form styling
- Grouped related fields
- Character limits displayed
- Auto-save functionality
- Validation feedback
```

---

## ⚙️ **5. User Management & Permissions Interface**

### **5.1 User Dashboard Requirements**

#### **Core Functionality:**
- **User Overview**: Statistics and user metrics
- **User CRUD**: Create, view, edit, delete users
- **Role Management**: Assign and modify user roles
- **Account Status**: Active, inactive, suspended states
- **Bulk Operations**: Mass user management actions
- **Audit Logging**: Track user activities and changes

#### **UI/UX Requirements:**
```
Dashboard Layout:
├── Statistics Overview (1200x200px):
│   ├── Total Users card (Blue gradient)
│   ├── Active Users card (Green gradient)
│   ├── Admins card (Purple gradient)
│   ├── Authors card (Teal gradient)
│   └── Readers card (Blue gradient)
├── Filters & Search Bar (1200x60px):
│   ├── Search input (300px width)
│   ├── Role filter dropdown
│   ├── Status filter
│   └── Add User button (primary blue)
└── Users Table (1200x500px):
    ├── User info (avatar + name + ID)
    ├── Email address
    ├── Role badge
    ├── Status indicator
    ├── Last activity
    └── Action buttons

Statistics Cards Design:
- Consistent size: 200x80px
- Gradient backgrounds with matching colors
- Large numbers with descriptive labels
- Subtle shadow effects
- Hover animations
```

### **5.2 Permissions Matrix Interface**

#### **Core Functionality:**
- **Role Management**: Create, edit, delete user roles
- **Permission Assignment**: Granular permission control
- **Matrix Visualization**: Clear view of role-permission relationships
- **Conflict Detection**: Identify and resolve permission conflicts
- **Inheritance Rules**: Parent-child role relationships
- **Audit Trail**: Log all permission changes

#### **UI/UX Requirements:**
```
Matrix Layout:
├── Roles Panel (400px width):
│   ├── Role cards with color coding:
│   │   ├── Admin: Red theme (#DC2626)
│   │   ├── Author: Green theme (#059669)
│   │   └── Reader: Blue theme (#3B82F6)
│   ├── Add Role button
│   └── Role management actions
└── Permissions Table (800px width):
    ├── Function list (rows)
    ├── Role columns
    ├── Permission checkboxes
    └── Bulk actions toolbar

Role Card Design:
- Size: 340x100px
- Colored border (2px)
- Matching background tint
- Role name and description
- User count indicator
- Edit/delete actions

Permission Matrix:
- Clear grid layout
- Visual checkboxes (✓ = allowed, ✗ = denied, ~ = partial)
- Color coding: Green=allowed, Red=denied, Orange=partial
- Hover effects on cells
- Batch selection options
```

### **5.3 Advanced Permission Features**

#### **Core Functionality:**
- **Conflict Resolution**: Detect overlapping permissions
- **Permission Reports**: Generate permission audit reports
- **Temporary Permissions**: Time-based permission grants
- **Permission Templates**: Pre-defined role templates
- **API Access Control**: Manage API endpoint permissions

#### **UI/UX Requirements:**
```
Advanced Tools Panel:
├── Conflict Detection:
│   ├── Scan for conflicts button
│   ├── Conflict report display
│   └── Resolution suggestions
├── Reporting Tools:
│   ├── Generate report button
│   ├── Export options (PDF, CSV)
│   └── Report parameters
└── Template Management:
    ├── Save as template
    ├── Load template
    └── Template library

Report Interface:
- Clean, printable layout
- User permission summary
- Role distribution charts
- Activity timeline
- Export functionality
```

---

## 📱 **6. Responsive Design Requirements**

### **6.1 Mobile Interface (375px - 768px)**

#### **Navigation:**
- **Hamburger Menu**: Collapsible navigation drawer
- **Bottom Tab Bar**: Quick access to main sections
- **Swipe Gestures**: Navigate between screens
- **Pull-to-Refresh**: Update content with pull gesture

#### **Layout Adaptations:**
```
Mobile Specific Features:
- Touch-optimized buttons (minimum 44px height)
- Card-based layouts for easy scrolling
- Floating action buttons for primary actions
- Simplified forms with step-by-step flow
- Thumb-friendly navigation
```

### **6.2 Tablet Interface (768px - 1024px)**

#### **Hybrid Layouts:**
- **Adaptive Sidebar**: Collapsible on smaller tablets
- **Multi-column Layouts**: Utilize available screen space
- **Touch-friendly Tables**: Larger touch targets
- **Split-view**: Master-detail interfaces

---

## 🎨 **7. Design System Requirements**

### **7.1 Visual Standards**

#### **Color Palette:**
```css
/* Primary Brand Colors */
--primary-50: #EFF6FF
--primary-500: #3B82F6
--primary-600: #2563EB
--primary-900: #1E3A8A

/* Semantic Colors */
--success: #10B981
--warning: #F59E0B
--error: #EF4444
--info: #06B6D4

/* Neutral Grays */
--gray-50: #F8FAFC
--gray-100: #F1F5F9
--gray-500: #64748B
--gray-900: #1E293B
```

#### **Typography Scale:**
```css
/* Font Family */
font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif

/* Scale */
--text-xs: 12px/16px    /* Captions, helper text */
--text-sm: 14px/20px    /* Small body text */
--text-base: 16px/24px  /* Default body text */
--text-lg: 18px/28px    /* Large body text */
--text-xl: 20px/28px    /* Small headings */
--text-2xl: 24px/32px   /* Medium headings */
--text-3xl: 30px/36px   /* Large headings */
--text-4xl: 36px/40px   /* Extra large headings */
```

### **7.2 Component Library**

#### **Button Variants:**
```css
/* Primary Button */
background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3B82F6, #2563EB)
padding: 12px 24px
border-radius: 8px
font-weight: 600
box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3)

/* Secondary Button */
background: white
border: 1px solid #E2E8F0
color: #64748B
padding: 12px 24px
border-radius: 8px

/* Success/Warning/Error variants with appropriate colors */
```

#### **Form Elements:**
```css
/* Input Fields */
background: #F8FAFC
border: 1px solid #E2E8F0
padding: 12px 16px
border-radius: 8px
font-size: 16px

/* Focus State */
border-color: #3B82F6
box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1)
```

#### **Card Components:**
```css
/* Base Card */
background: white
border: 1px solid #F1F5F9
border-radius: 12px
box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)

/* Elevated Card */
box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)

/* Interactive Card */
transition: all 0.2s ease
hover: transform: translateY(-2px)
hover: box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)
```

---

## 🔧 **8. Technical Requirements**

### **8.1 Performance Standards**
- **Loading Time**: Maximum 3 seconds for initial page load
- **Image Optimization**: WebP format with fallbacks
- **Lazy Loading**: Implement for images and non-critical content
- **Caching Strategy**: Browser and CDN caching implementation

### **8.2 Accessibility Requirements**
- **WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance**: Meet accessibility standards
- **Keyboard Navigation**: Full functionality without mouse
- **Screen Reader Support**: Proper ARIA labels and semantic HTML
- **Color Contrast**: Minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text

### **8.3 Browser Support**
- **Modern Browsers**: Chrome 90+, Firefox 88+, Safari 14+, Edge 90+
- **Progressive Enhancement**: Core functionality for older browsers
- **Feature Detection**: Graceful degradation for unsupported features

---

## 📊 **9. Analytics & Monitoring**

### **9.1 User Behavior Tracking**
- **Page Views**: Track most visited sections
- **User Flows**: Monitor navigation patterns
- **Feature Usage**: Identify popular features
- **Error Tracking**: Monitor and log user errors

### **9.2 Performance Monitoring**
- **Core Web Vitals**: LCP, FID, CLS monitoring
- **Real User Monitoring**: Track actual user performance
- **Error Reporting**: Automated error logging and alerts

---

**📋 Total Estimated Development Time: 16-20 weeks**  
**🎨 Design Complexity: High (Professional Academic Platform)**  
**👥 Target Users: 1000+ concurrent users**  
**🔧 Technology Stack: Modern web framework with responsive design**
"}
